metadata.title: Administrative Systems – Data SSPP Overlay
metadata.remarks: Secure Data overlay governing administrative, financial, and personnel data systems.

props.name: data-classification-assumption
props.remarks: Administrative data is assumed to require the highest level of protection by default.

props.name: sharing-restriction
props.remarks: External data sharing is exceptional and requires explicit authorization.

props.name: legal-hold-priority
props.remarks: Legal holds override automated retention and disposal.

control-implementation.remarks: Administrative systems strictly inherit Secure Data classification, encryption, DLP, and retention requirements.
